# Day 4: Control Structures

## If statement

```{r}
# random number between 0 and 100
x <- runif(1, 0, 100)
x

# random numbers
y <- rnorm(100)
hist(y)

# if / else if / else
if (x > 3) {
  print("X is greater than 3")
} else if (x < 3) {
  print("X is less than 3")
} else {
  print("X is equal to 3")
}
```

## If statement with a number between 0 and 10

```{r}
# one random number between 0 and 10
x <- runif(1, 0, 10)
x

if (x > 3) {
  print("X is greater than three")
} else {
  print("X is less or equal to three")
}
```

## Short if (assign y)

```{r}
# y gets 10 if x > 3, otherwise 0
y <- if (x > 3) {
  10
} else {
  0
}
y
```

## For loop

```{r}
# loop over a list of words
items <- c("a", "b", "c", "d")

for (item in items) {
  print(item)
}

# loop over numbers 1 to 5
for (i in 1:5) {
  print(i)
}
```

## While loop

```{r}
# count down from 10 to 1
count <- 10
while (count >= 1) {
  print(count)
  count <- count - 1
}
```
# count NA values in each column
nrow(airquality)     # number of rows: 153
for (col in names(airquality)) {
  cat(col, ":", sum(is.na(airquality[[col]])), "missing\n")
}
f1 <- function(x, y) {
  result <- (x^2) + (y^2) + (2*x*y) - 3
  return(result)
}
